strategy.audience: 20-35 year old regular gym-goers who rush through workouts and plateau without knowing why
strategy.core_insight: Static stretching before lifting actually weakens your muscle contractions, turning your warm-up into a progress killer.
strategy.reasoning: A bold claim immediately challenges common fitness dogma and creates tension for an audience that values efficiency. The problem-agitate-solve structure allows us to dismantle the old habit, highlight the negative impact on their strength gains, and offer a scientifically backed replacement routine.

hook_candidates.text: Stretching your hamstrings right before heavy squats is actively cutting your muscle strength by up to thirty percent every single time.
Your static warm up routine is the exact reason why your bench press numbers have been stuck for the last three months.
Doing traditional stretches before lifting weights makes your muscle fibers weaker and sabotages every single rep of your entire workout.
